thread:
Alex S. (Support): FYI created ticket #14287 — ClearWave onboarding hitting bad embedding similarity results post-ingest, customer sees mismatched answers and search relevance drop. They mentioned renewal in 6 weeks, flagging as high risk. link: https://tickets.redwood/14287
Priya K. (CS Manager): Thanks Alex. Can you paste the minimal repro and the ingest job id? We need to triage before EOD. assigning to CS.
Alex S. (Support): repro attached, ingest job id cw-ingest-2026-03-12. Quick sample: `query: "find patient onboarding guide" -> top hit: unrelated marketing doc`. Also seeing many low-sim scores on latest batch (avg 0.12).
Ben R. (Solutions Eng): putting this on my radar. Can you drop the embed model + quantization details? CPU/GPU not needed for now.
Alex S. (Support): model: openembed-large-v2, quant: 8bit, dims 1024. Embed call trace: `POST /v1/embeddings {model: "openembed-large-v2", input: [...]}`. Logs: `ingest-worker cw-ingest-2026-03-12 ERR: mismatched-dim` but most rows succeeded.
Lena M. (Account Manager): looping in — I'll request an immediate customer sync. When's earliest you can do a deep-dive, Ben? I can offer Wed 10am PT.
Ben R. (Solutions Eng): Wed 10am PT works. I'll run a quick local check before then. Alex, can you export a redwood-compat archive of the failing docs (`/admin/export cw-ingest-2026-03-12 --filter low-sim`) and drop it in the ticket?
Alex S. (Support): done, uploaded to ticket #14287.
OnboardBot: Automated note: Customer ClearWave is on plan: Growth (renewal 2026-04-22). SLA: standard. Estimated MRR: $18,200.
Priya K. (CS Manager): Comms plan (short):
- Immediate: confirm Wed 10am PT customer call (Lena owns invite).
- Pre-call: Ben to validate top 20 failing queries + quick root-cause hypothesis (embedding mismatch vs ingest mapping). Ben should share 2 slide summary.
- Remediation window: if issue is ingest mapping -> patch + reingest (estimate 2-3 days). If model mismatch -> recommend quant/variant rollback or custom prompt-layer filter (estimate 1-2 days to validate).
- Post-call: create playbook snippet for this failure mode and link to ticket.
Please react with :thumbsup: if you can own.
Lena M. (Account Manager): I will own invites and post-call customer comms. I'll mention we're prioritizing this due to renewal.
Ben R. (Solutions Eng): I'll own the pre-call validation + slides. Will check quantization parity and run sample embeddings locally.
Alex S. (Support): I'll stand by during the call and escalate logs in real-time. Also flagged a possible duplicate doc id mapping issue in the ingest mapping — added note in ticket.
Priya K. (CS Manager): Risk mitigation steps for renewal: 1) Offer 2-week SLA-backed remediation window (if we need to reingest) 2) Temporary credit or service extension if root cause on our side 3) Weekly status updates to customer until resolved. Agree?
Lena M. (Account Manager): Agree on status cadence. I'll draft the customer-facing note after the call.
Ben R. (Solutions Eng): Quick ask: can support provide a sample of full metadata for one failing doc (headers + original text + resulting vector). That will speed debugging.
Alex S. (Support): grabbing sample now, pushing to ticket.
Priya K. (CS Manager): Good. Follow-ups: Ben — add a short checklist to the ticket with steps to validate (dims, tokenization diffs, embedding drift). Alex — monitor for any additional similar tickets from other customers (signal). Lena — confirm invite sent and customer's primary contact.
Lena M. (Account Manager): Invite sent to ClearWave: "Wed Mar 19 10:00 PT - ClearWave onboarding deep-dive". Contacts: carla@clearwave.com, dan@clearwave.com.
Ben R. (Solutions Eng): A couple minutes check: I see 0.12 avg sim on the batch but baseline historically ~0.76. Looks like a vector normalization step might have been skipped during a new ingest micro-batch. Hypothesis logged in ticket.
Priya K. (CS Manager): Perfect. We'll treat this as high priority. If remediation is >48 hours, we'll prep a short concession and draft customer-facing timeline. Thanks team.
Alex S. (Support): noted. standing by. :white_check_mark:
Lena M. (Account Manager): I'll post the post-call summary in #customer-updates after the meeting.
Ben R. (Solutions Eng): prepping slides now.
Priya K. (CS Manager): Thanks all — ping here if anything changes.
